assertions.claim: Among confirmed pulmonary embolism cases, 3-month all-cause mortality is 17.4% (426/2454, ICOPER, 52 hospitals in 7 countries).
assertions.cn_span: 确诊肺栓塞的人 3 个月内死亡 17.4%

assertions.claim: Sitting >4 hours roughly doubles venous thromboembolism risk (WHO WRIGHT), but absolute risk stays low — about one in six thousand after >4h immobile sitting.
assertions.cn_span: 久坐超过 4 小时风险大约翻倍，但绝对概率仍然很低

assertions.claim: Both legs swelling at once is usually heart, liver, kidney or venous insufficiency; one suddenly swollen leg thicker by a circle is typical DVT.
assertions.cn_span: 两条腿一起肿多半是心、肝、肾或静脉功能的问题

assertions.claim: Added sudden breathlessness, chest pain on deep breath, fast pulse, dizziness → clot may be in the lungs, call 120 immediately.
assertions.cn_span: 突然喘不上气、深吸气时胸痛、心跳快、发晕，血栓可能已经跑到肺里，直接打 120

assertions.claim: 17.4% is mortality among confirmed PE cases, not the risk of a swollen leg — don't scare yourself with this number.
assertions.cn_span: 17.4% 是确诊肺栓塞病例的死亡率，不是「腿肿了就有这么大风险」
